**Pearson IIT Foundation Practice Book Series** is designed to accompany the
course-books available in this series. Developed by a team of experienced faculties, this
workbook series connects the subjective knowledge to its real world applications through
various text and chapter-level problems. Each chapter has a set of assessment tests
which are mapped to chapters covered in the course-book. These assessment tests will
guide students step-by-step towards understanding the central concept of that particular
chapter. These tests are recommended (after class material) for further practice.

The image is a graphical infographic or banner displaying a collection of educational materials, specifically 'Chemistry Practice Books' and 'Physics Practice Books', organized by academic grade level. The layout is divided into four vertical columns, each representing a specific grade level: Class 7, Class 8, Class 9, and Class 10. Each column features a light blue background with a pattern of triangular shapes at the bottom. Inside each column, there are three rows of book covers. The top row in every column contains the 'Chemistry Practice Book' cover, which features a colorful, abstract, pixelated design. The middle row in every column contains the 'Physics Practice Book' cover, which features a similar abstract design but with a different color palette (orange, green, blue, or red). The bottom row in every column contains the 'Mathematics Practice Book' cover, which has a distinct blue and white pixelated design. The text labels 'Class 7', 'Class 8', 'Class 9', and 'Class 10' are prominently displayed in white text on blue headers at the top of each respective column. A vertical watermark on the right side reads 'Cover image: Maya2008.shutterstock.com'.

The image displays a standard Universal Product Code (UPC) barcode accompanied by its corresponding International Standard Book Number (ISBN) text. At the top of the image, the text reads "ISBN 978-93-528-6771-4". Below this text is the barcode itself, a linear array of vertical black bars of varying widths separated by white spaces. Directly beneath the barcode, the numerical digits "9 789352867714" are printed, which correspond to the barcode's data. The first digit "9" is positioned above the first group of bars, and the final digit "4" is positioned below the last group of bars.
